summary: The proposal also outlines two partitioning strategies and a bulk ingest write path, aiming to improve analytical database performance while keeping JDBC as the fallback. Hyukjin Kwon is running a trial of an AI code review bot for new Apache Spark pull requests, using Claude to analyze diffs and post inline comments without approving or LGTM. The proposal introduces a unified API and execution protocol for user-defined functions (UDFs) that can run across multiple programming languages in Spark Connect, enabling external workers via inter-process communication (IPC). Participants raise points about missing DSv2 interface details, test coverage plans, executor-level caching, and potential support for external APIs beyond OLTP.
